 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition is filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 149/2024dated 20th February under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC r/w Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961registered at P.S Seemapuri, on the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties dated14thMarch, 2024, which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner no.1-2and respondent no.2 are present in the Court, in person and are duly identified by the IO, as also by their respective counsels.

Petitioner no.3 is also present through VC.
3.
Respondent no.2 states that she has received the full amount of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/07/2024 at 03:48:25 settlement of Rs. 8.25 lacs and has no objection to the FIR being quashed.
4. The marriage of the petitioner no.1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 22nd April, 2022 and has since been dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 28th May, 2024.
No child was born out of the wedlock.

sentences.text: Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No. 149/2024 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC r/w Section 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 registered at P.S Seemapuri and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, is disposed of as infructuous.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J JULY 12, 2024/RK
